Why UBC

One Licensed Contractor.
All of Tampa Bay.

Unique Building Contractors LLC is a Florida Certified Building Contractor, not a referral network or a sub-trade. When you hire UBC, you get a single licensed team managing every permit, trade, and inspection on your project — from initial planning through the final walkthrough.

Our license (CBC1268844) is valid statewide and authorizes us to pull permits in every county and municipality we serve — Hillsborough, Pinellas, Pasco, Sarasota, and beyond.
